newsitem.title: USA: Edison starts Australia coal-fired plant.
newsitem.headline: Edison starts Australia coal-fired plant.

text.p: Edison Mission Energy, a unit of Edison International, said Wednesday the 500 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the coal-fired Loy Yang power plant near Melbourne, Australia, began commercial operation Tuesday.
The plant's 500 MW unit 1 began operation about three years ago.
Edison, the operator, owns 51 percent of the plant and the State Electricity Commission of Victoria (SECV) owns the rest. Edison's electricity from the plant's production is also sold to SECV.
Edison Mission Energy's investments include 54 projects totaling approximately 9,300 MW of generation capacity that are in operation or under construction worldwide.
Parent company Edison International also owns Southern California Edison Co.
